top_signals.title: Stocks Erase Gains as Nvidia’s Rally Offsets Rate Hike Rumbles
top_signals.summary: US stocks on Wednesday afternoon erased the morning’s gains, following Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates and as strategists see profit taking in the recent tech rally. Megacap Nvidia Corp. extended its rally into a fifth day on confidence in artificial-intelligence related spending, contributing the most to the S&P 500 Index on a points basis.

top_signals.title: Ghana Made $1.9 Billion Loss on Gold Purchases in 2025, IMF Says
top_signals.summary: Ghana’s central bank incurred losses of 22 billion cedis ($1.9 billion) in 2025 under a domestic gold purchase program aimed at boosting the country’s foreign-exchange reserves.
